description: This source file implements functions for translating OpenGL ES shader texture functions into HLSL code, including handling of texture coordinate wrapping, size queries, and sampling functions. It defines a class for managing texture functions and generates corresponding HLSL code snippets.

classes.name: TextureFunctionHLSL::TextureFunction
classes.description: Represents a specific texture function with parameters such as sampler type, coordinates, method, projection, and offset. Provides methods to generate unique function names and determine return types based on parameters.

methods.name: TextureFunctionHLSL::useTextureFunction
methods.description: Determines the appropriate texture function based on the function name, sampler type, argument count, and shader type. Sets internal parameters for the texture function accordingly.

methods.name: TextureFunctionHLSL::textureFunctionHeader
methods.description: Generates the HLSL code for all used texture functions, including function headers, bodies for size queries, sampling, and gather operations, based on the internal set of texture functions.
